investigations.summary: PSMDB Replica 6.x/7.x/8.x on clients 3.8.0-3.10.0 (15 lanes): 8 tests failed with 'pmm-admin: error: unexpected argument update'. versionGate skipped them, but the afterEach hooks of 'more update flags' and update-target (new in #1793) still ran pmm-admin update. Reproduced on a VM with the 3.8.0 client: main 8 failed, fix 15 skipped.

help tests (pmm3-rc): PMM-T2751-T2753 failed with 'Unexpected end of JSON input'. getPmmAdminVersion ran the host's pmm-admin without sudo, and the pmm-client package leaves /usr/local/percona at 0750. Reproduced as a non-root sudo user; the fix uses sudo pmm-admin and passes.

PMM-T2631 (CLI and GSSAPI OL8 PSMDB Replica 8.x, rc): 'No history before the update: []'. The precondition's unpinned query reads 5 s back (VictoriaMetrics latencyOffset), so it was satisfied before PMM-T2630's exporter restart. beforeUpdate then fell in the restart gap; the CI nginx log shows it. Did not reproduce on the VM; the fix waits for a sample of the running exporter first.

PMM-T1889 (GSSAPI OL9 PSMDB e2e): Replication Lag Max stayed at 8 s on all 3 attempts. #1794 requires Max >= the 10 s delay, but the whole-second lag of a 10 s delayed member moves between 8 and 10 s (measured on the VM). Fix requires half the delay; PMM-T1775 has the same assertion and gets the same fix.

Generic (ps,ENCRYPTED_CLIENT_CONFIG=true on the pmm3-rc package): pmm-agent setup with --config-file-key-file fails with 'unable to RSA-unwrap AES key' because the package's pmm-agent has already written a plain-text pmm-agent.yaml. Reproduced on 3.11.0-rc and 3.10.0; an empty file works. Tarball installs (the usual nightly) don't start pmm-agent first.
